name: ballerina/constraint
description: This module provides features to validate the values with respect to the constraints defined to the respective Ballerina types.

typeDefs.name: ConstraintRecord
typeDefs.description: Represents the constraint details as a record.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value for the constraint

fields.name: message
fields.description: The message to be returned in case of the constraint violation

typeDefs.name: IntConstraints
typeDefs.description: Represents the constraints associated with `int` type.

fields.name: minValue
fields.description: The inclusive lower bound of the constrained type

fields.name: maxValue
fields.description: The inclusive upper bound of the constrained type

fields.name: minValueExclusive
fields.description: The exclusive lower bound of the constrained type

fields.name: maxValueExclusive
fields.description: The exclusive upper bound of the constrained type

fields.name: maxDigits
fields.description: The maximum number of digits in the constrained type

typeDefs.name: FloatConstraints
typeDefs.description: Represents the constraints associated with `float` type.

fields.name: minValue
fields.description: The inclusive lower bound of the constrained type

fields.name: maxValue
fields.description: The inclusive upper bound of the constrained type

fields.name: minValueExclusive
fields.description: The exclusive lower bound of the constrained type

fields.name: maxValueExclusive
fields.description: The exclusive upper bound of the constrained type

fields.name: maxIntegerDigits
fields.description: The maximum number of digits in the integer part of the constrained type

fields.name: maxFractionDigits
fields.description: The maximum number of digits in the fraction part of the constrained type

typeDefs.name: NumberConstraints
typeDefs.description: Represents the constraints associated with `int`, `float` and `decimal` types.

fields.name: minValue
fields.description: The inclusive lower bound of the constrained type

fields.name: maxValue
fields.description: The inclusive upper bound of the constrained type

fields.name: minValueExclusive
fields.description: The exclusive lower bound of the constrained type

fields.name: maxValueExclusive
fields.description: The exclusive upper bound of the constrained type

fields.name: maxIntegerDigits
fields.description: The maximum number of digits in the integer part of the constrained type

fields.name: maxFractionDigits
fields.description: The maximum number of digits in the fraction part of the constrained type

typeDefs.name: StringConstraints
typeDefs.description: Represents the constraints associated with `string` type.

fields.name: length
fields.description: The number of characters of the constrained `string` type

fields.name: minLength
fields.description: The inclusive lower bound of the number of characters of the constrained `string` type

fields.name: maxLength
fields.description: The inclusive upper bound of the number of characters of the constrained `string` type

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: The regular expression to be matched with the constrained `string` type

typeDefs.name: ArrayConstraints
typeDefs.description: Represents the constraints associated with `anydata[]` type.

fields.name: length
fields.description: The number of members of the constrained type

fields.name: minLength
fields.description: The inclusive lower bound of the number of members of the constrained type

fields.name: maxLength
fields.description: The inclusive upper bound of the number of members of the constrained type

typeDefs.name: DateOption
typeDefs.description: Represents the date option to be validated.

typeDefs.name: DateConstraints
typeDefs.description: Represents the constraints associated with `Date` type.

fields.name: option
fields.description: date option to be validated

fields.name: message
fields.description: The message to be returned in case of the constraint violation

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Represents the generic error type of the module.

typeDefs.name: ValidationError
typeDefs.description: Represents the errors occurs during constraint validations.

typeDefs.name: TypeConversionError
typeDefs.description: Represents the errors occurs during the type conversion.

functions.name: validate
functions.description:
Validates the provided value against the configured annotations. Additionally, if the type of the value is different
from the expected return type then the value will be cloned with the contextually expected type before the validation.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The `anydata` type value to be constrained

parameters.name: td
parameters.description: The type descriptor of the value to be constrained

return.description: The type descriptor of the value which is validated or else an `constraint:Error` in case of an error
